project.title: Example Aesthetics — Complete brand, web & AI engagement
project.summary: A scoped Complete engagement integrating a refreshed brand, a rebuilt clinic website, and AI Growth automation into one governed programme of work.
objectives: AI Growth automation for patient enquiry handling
One governed engagement across brand, web and AI

deliverables: Integrated brand, web and AI go-live
exclusions: Ongoing changes after go-live (Web Care is separate and optional)

timeline.notes: Integrated programme; final schedule confirmed at agreement

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

Required copy, imagery and access before each phase
assumptions: Complete is a scoped engagement priced by the Approved Final Project Price — not a mechanical A+B+C sum and not automatically discounted
The 30/30/30/10 payment schedule totals 100%; the first 30% is part of the total, not an additional deposit
AI monthly billing begins at Go-Live, never before
